create_GradientClipper: create a GradientClipper instance with configs specifying module names, max norms, and norm types for gradient clipping
setup_GradientClipper: setup gradient clipping on a PyTorch model by mapping parameters to configured module name groups
call_GradientClipper: call the GradientClipper to apply gradient clipping and return per-group gradient norms
configure_multi_group_clipping: configure different gradient clipping rules for different model parts like FSDP and DDP modules
validate_all_params_clipped: validate that all trainable model parameters are covered by at least one clipping configuration
